notes: DGX Spark GB10 with 128 GB unified system memory; container OS Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS; BF16 verified in-container; single accelerator reserved; persistence mode enabled; device power limit is not exposed by nvidia-smi. vLLM 0.26.0 is launched with --chat-template /runtime/template.jinja; the runtime template emits the model image token only, so vLLM adds the single official image start/image/end sequence expected by HunyuanOCR-1.5. GPU memory utilization is fixed at 0.35 because GPU and host share the Spark 128 GB unified memory; 0.90 exhausted system memory and was rejected during preflight.
